title: Astronomers witness supermassive black hole gorge on a cosmic meal before 'burping' radio jets 300 days later
caption:
Astronomers observed a supermassive black hole in galaxy NGC 1275 'burping' radio jets 300 days after a major X-ray flare. This observation helps scientists understand the link between a black hole's feeding habits and how it impacts galaxy growth.

Source: Space - Astronomers witness supermassive black hole gorge on a cosmic meal before 'burping' radio jets 300 days later
